info.title: Dialograft API
info.description: Demo invoicing API. Demo data only, no accounting documents.

post.summary: List open invoices as of a reference date, optionally only those overdue by at least N days.
Summarize open and overdue amounts per customer.
Render an invoice draft as PDF.
Render the open items report as PDF.
Export the open items report as a real .xlsx with numeric amounts and sums.
Export the open items report as CSV (Deutsch, semicolon-separated, UTF-8 with BOM for Excel).

Run a payment reminder check. Sends one reminder email per invoice that is at least 14 days overdue and not yet fully paid, but only if no reminder was sent before. Uses the optional asOf reference date (default: today).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional key; repeating a call with the same key returns the first result.

post.summary: Run a second payment reminder check (Mahnstufe 2). Sends one reminder email per invoice that is at least 30 days overdue and not yet fully paid, but only if a first reminder (Mahnstufe 1) was already sent. Uses the optional asOf reference date (default: today).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional key; repeating a call with the same key returns the first result.

post.summary: List feature requests and their status.

Start a feature request after the user agreed to have a missing function checked. Put everything the user already said into scope so it is not asked again. Returns missing fields; ask about them one at a time.

Update scope fields. Mark your suggestions as decisions with status "proposed" until the user confirms them. Changing an assessed scope invalidates open offers.
